notes.title: Early Access now Available
notes.content:
I'm so happy to announce that the very first early access version of Broadcast Empire has now gone live.

I'm aiming to bring loads of new features to this game and evolve it hugely over the next 12 months. I'd love your feedback and suggestions on the way to make this a fully featured fun experience.

Currently, it's a bit basic, it's a playable proof of concept that will expand - join me on this exciting journey and see where we can take this.

notes.title: Early Beta Playtest now live
notes.content:
I'm excited to announce that our limited Playtest beta is now available for download.

This is for feedback purposes at this stage, many gameplay activities are still to be added and will be rolled out over the next few weeks.

The playtest does not send through achievements and stats to steam and is limited to just 10 days of gameplay. Games saved in the playtest should be playable in the full early access version once that's release
